Paramilitary drone strike in Sudan kills 41, rights group reports

A drone strike attributed to Sudan's paramilitary forces has killed 41 displaced people near the Ethiopian border, according to a rights group. Eight children were reportedly among the victims. The strike targeted a gathering of displaced individuals.
